title: Planet Tweaks V2.3.2 ULTRA — PowerToys Keyboard Manager & Customize Mode
releaseNotes: V2.3.2 ULTRA Release: PowerToys Keyboard Manager redesign with compact keycap pills and zero ugly KPI boxes; Fullscreen/Maximize window support with title bar button and taskbar docking; Fixed minimize-to-taskbar & auto-tray bugs; Interactive Customize Mode with Left/Right sidebar switcher; 0ms Instant Build & Drag Edit macro sub-tick latency; Category load crash protection.
